features.name: Technical reverse review
features.description: Review the source plan for feasibility, architecture, model capability, video processing, cost, and one-person maintenance; refine the smallest Phase 0 loop.
features.test_criteria: A dated review in docs/exec-plans identifies key risks, evidence, decisions, and any changes to the Phase 0 scope.

features.name: CLI input and project skeleton
features.description: Prepare isolated, pinned CPython 3.13/uv/venv tools and a four-layer Python CLI package with typed domain/provider contracts and local input validation.
features.test_criteria: Reproducible package build, pytest/Ruff/mypy and import-direction checks pass using project-local tools/caches, with no Windows Python registration or global links; missing/unreadable video returns the specified input error without output.

features.name: Local media preprocessing
features.description: Use FFmpeg locally to probe media and extract timestamped audio and visual evidence.
features.test_criteria: Representative and synthetic VFR/nonzero-PTS clips produce traceable source timecodes; no-audio, malformed input and cancellation are handled cleanly.

features.name: Replaceable model analysis
features.description: Implement local ASR and replaceable vision analysis, produce validated semantic events, and record per-attempt model, usage and cost metadata.
features.test_criteria: Provider replacement is verified; ASR distinguishes no_audio/no_speech/failure; schema, usage, budget and retry checks pass with per-attempt model/prompt/cost/time records and unknown costs preserved.

features.name: Persistent semantic timeline
features.description: Store media references, timestamped semantic events, and analysis metadata in SQLite.
features.test_criteria: A second process reloads the timeline; migrations/FKs and interrupted-stage/file-integrity recovery pass; unknown request costs survive recovery; full source video bytes are absent from SQLite.

features.name: Natural-language clip retrieval
features.description: Rank timeline segments against a text query and return useful clip ranges with evidence.
features.test_criteria: A query returns stable, deduplicated source intervals with evidence from a Completed run; empty results are valid; lexical and semantic retrieval are compared on fixed fixtures.

features.name: Retrieval benchmark and gate
features.description: Evaluate ranked results against human judgments and report quality, runtime, and model cost.
features.test_criteria: A frozen independent human-labeled benchmark reports every query, fixed-denominator U10, misses/timecode errors, runtime and cold/hot cost; each main mechanic query reaches U10 >= 0.70; sparse/negative groups are separate and unverified cost gates remain null.

features.name: Local inspection workspace
features.description: User-authorized local project/run inspection, source playback, evidence, filtered timeline and selected-interval manifests; does not replace the F006 human gate or implement video rendering.
features.test_criteria: Registered source/evidence HTTP boundaries and Range/HEAD/errors pass; real existing footage supports search, seek/end pause, evidence preview, isolated basket restoration and identity-preserving JSON/CSV export; browser behavior checks cover stale responses and text safety using project-isolated tools.

features.name: Workspace layout and chronological clip basket
features.description: Apply user UI acceptance feedback: professional workstation layout with visible preview/timeline/basket, independent list scrolling and chronological selections without changing retrieval ranks.
features.test_criteria: Real browser checks show preview, timeline and basket together at 1440x900 and 1366x768 without page scrolling, keep a deep timeline position through selection, preserve all existing playback/evidence behavior, sort basket/storage/JSON/CSV by source start/end/identity and avoid mobile horizontal overflow.

features.name: Temporal gameplay analysis correction
features.description: Address rejected gameplay retrieval with ordered multi-frame action analysis, conservative action evidence and bounded real-video comparisons; this technical change does not pass F006.
features.test_criteria: A separately fingerprinted temporal prompt preserves legacy runs, rejects unordered or single-frame action claims, supports a denser source-clock-preserving profile and resumable windows, and records bounded real-video comparisons including static controls and all attempt costs. Independent action retrieval quality remains F006.

features.name: Actor-bound visual detail retrieval and clean descriptions
features.description: Address user feedback with visible appearance, clothing, held items, environment and action effects bound to their actors; remove internal frame aliases from human-facing descriptions while preserving frozen source facts.
features.test_criteria: Versioned V5/V6 detailed analysis and higher-resolution evidence preserve legacy contracts and resumable runs; uncertainty stays outside positive indexing and facts require review. Actor/part-bound observed attributes with shared supporting evidence must satisfy all strict compound constraints; unknown or cross-actor facts cannot be full matches. Original facts/basket validation remain intact; bounded real-video comparisons record every cost/control and independent human judgments confirm useful detail queries. F006 remains separate.
